question: I've got some free time tonight, any documentary recommendations?

gold_sessions.user_turns:
[turn 0] I've been watching a lot of documentaries lately, especially on Netflix. Can you recommend some more documentary series similar to "Our Planet", "Free Solo", and "Tiger King", which I just finished?

[turn 2] I'm interested in the nature and wildlife documentaries. Can you tell me more about "Dynasties" and "Chasing Coral"? What makes them unique compared to "Our Planet" and "Planet Earth"?

[turn 4] I've seen some stunning footage of coral reefs before, but I've never really understood the importance of them. Can you tell me more about why coral reefs are so crucial to the ocean's ecosystem?

[turn 6] That's really interesting. So, what are some ways that we can help protect coral reefs?

[turn 8] I'm interested in learning more about eco-tourism. Can you recommend some popular destinations for eco-tourism and responsible travel that focus on coral reef conservation?

[turn 10] I'll choose a destination from your list. How about Belize? I've heard great things about the snorkeling and diving there. Can you tell me more about the eco-tourism opportunities in Belize?
